snippet.title: Core Keeper: Void & Voltage Official Trailer | New Game+ Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Explore a vast cavern of creatures, relics and resources in a mining sandbox adventure for 1-8 players. Mine, build, fight, craft and farm to unravel the mystery of the ancient Core.

Now, on January 28th, they’re bringing their biggest content drop since the 1.0 launch, alongside the debut of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.
And yes, the major update is completely free on all platforms.

Void & Voltage - Dive into Core Keeper’s biggest update of the year! 

The Northern Biome has opened at last filled with advanced robotics, void corruption, dangerous new enemies, and a colossal new boss lurking beyond the great door. Harness next-gen automation with cutting-edge machines, electricity, sensors, and upgraded logistics that revolutionize how players build, farm, and design bases. Arm yourself with flamethrowers, miniguns, mortars, and powerful new armour sets, then discover puzzle rooms, world-scale Void Breaches, and a huge collection of fresh decorations and environmental upgrades.

Wishlist or get Core Keeper HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621690/Core_Keeper/

The New Game + Showcase is a creator-led games showcase designed to put authentic excitement back at the center of game reveals. Unlike traditional showcases, we don’t accept paid placements—every game we feature is there because our team of six core creators is genuinely excited about it. Our goal is to give developers and publishers a stage where their game isn’t competing for attention with dozens of sponsored slots, but instead stands out in front of communities that want to discover it.

Started by Luke Stephens, Luality, Jake Lucky, IamRob, Blue Thunder, and HUN2R, and produced by Gaming World Media, the New Game+ Showcase aims to provide value for an audience eager for genuine recommendations, which streamlines discovery for indie, AA, and AAA projects. 

#newgame #newgames #newgameplus
